name: Grand Parkway Marketplace II
summary: Grand Parkway Marketplace II is a 241,225 square foot community shopping center located along the newly opened Grand Parkway in Spring, Texas. The modern open-air property serves affluent northern Houston suburbs with convenient access and ample parking, positioned across from its sister site Grand Parkway Marketplace.
demographics: Grand Parkway Marketplace II serves an affluent suburban Houston market with a median household income of $107,923 within one mile and $110,876 within three miles. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle class families with an average household income of $119,596 locally, drawing from a population of over 229,000 within five miles. The center's location along the newly opened Grand Parkway positions it to capture growing residential communities in Spring and The Woodlands area, with shoppers typically seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services in a modern open-air format.
description: Grand Parkway Marketplace II is a modern community shopping center strategically positioned at the intersection of Spring Stuebner Road and Kuykendahl Road in Spring, Texas, along the newly opened Grand Parkway corridor. Developed by Kimco Realty Corporation, this 241,225 square foot open-air center serves the rapidly growing northern Houston suburbs with convenient access to tens of thousands of shoppers in the affluent Spring and Woodlands communities. The property is located directly across from its sister development, Grand Parkway Marketplace, creating a significant retail destination in this high-growth area. With ample parking at a ratio of 6.41 spaces per 1,000 square feet, the center provides easy access for the surrounding population of over 874,000 residents within a 10-mile radius. The development capitalizes on the area's strong demographics, including a median household income exceeding $107,000 and serves as a key shopping destination for families seeking quality retail and services in a modern, accessible environment.
